tasks.title: Correct care contracts with exact timestamp ordering
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh forward-only public-contract correction from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA without merging or cherry-picking CONTRACT-CORR-001, CONTRACT-CORR-002, or any rejected Attempt. Reimplement the complete authoritative care timing and bounded resolution contract required by CONTRACT-CORR-002. Add one dependency-free package-root timestamp comparator that exactly orders every offset-aware value accepted by TimestampSchema, including arbitrary fractional precision, equivalent instants written with different offsets, omitted optional seconds, trailing fractional zeros, calendar boundaries, and year 0000. Export it with JSDoc that defines the already-validated input precondition and -1, 0, and 1 ordering semantics. Use exact integer calendar and offset arithmetic plus digit-wise fractional comparison without truncation, rounding, fixed precision, JavaScript Date parsing, or large exponentiation. Use the same comparator for AcknowledgedCareEventSchema and TimeRangeSchema. Do not narrow TimestampSchema, add a dependency, or change unrelated APIs. Preserve Clock.now as the sole authoritative command time, strict now-before-deadline semantics, caller-timestamp rejection, bounded persisted care resolution, migration-only legacy_unknown visibility, closure preservation, content-free resolution audits, examples, and documentation.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA and no rejected Attempt SHA is an ancestor
The public package exports one documented compareTimestamps function returning -1, 0, or 1 for any two values accepted by TimestampSchema
The comparator preserves arbitrary fractional precision without Date.parse, epoch-millisecond conversion, rounding, truncation, or a new dependency
Equivalent instants with different offsets, omitted optional seconds, or trailing fractional zeros compare equal
Microsecond, beyond-nanosecond, cross-day offset, leap-day, and year-0000 fixtures compare exactly

A notified acknowledgement with timedOutAt null at 2026-08-27T20:01:00.000998Z is accepted before a 2026-08-27T20:01:00.000999Z deadline; equality or later cannot produce the timely notified-to-acknowledged transition, while the existing escalated-to-acknowledged late path remains valid and is never classified as timely
TimeRangeSchema accepts a genuinely positive sub-millisecond range and rejects canonically equal endpoints
Strict request schemas reject acknowledgedAt and handledAt supplied by callers
Handled events require one bounded resolution, closed events preserve it, and legacy_unknown remains history-only
Resolution audits remain bounded and content-free, and every public operation/schema example validates
TimestampSchema is not narrowed and no lockfile, unrelated API, privacy, handover, or UI contract changes

tasks.title: Correct private conversation with exact Unicode disclosure folding
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh conversation capability from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA without merging or cherry-picking CONV-001, CONV-REPAIR-001, CONV-REPAIR-002, or any rejected Attempt. Before provider invocation, authorize the active actor, space, private message, evidence ownership and state, and same-speaker analysis consent, and deterministically bypass the provider for every frozen high-risk category. Permit only bounded provider fields combined with human-authored templates and recursively inspect every provider-derived string, nested value, rendered draft, and shared signal. Implement Unicode Default Full Case Folding from a version-fixed complete mapping or a demonstrably equivalent exact implementation; NFKC plus uppercase/lowercase closure alone is forbidden. Preserve multi-code-point mappings including U+1E9E capital sharp S and U+00DF sharp S to ss, final sigma, canonical and compatibility normalization, whitespace, punctuation, symbols, containment, and one-code-point edit detection. ConfirmSignal must enter its transaction before authoritative Clock.now reads, lock and reread actor, consent, evidence, visibility, and versions, and revalidate immediately before persistence. Raw evidence and private messages remain self-only, while logs and errors remain content-free.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA and no rejected Attempt SHA is an ancestor
Unauthorized, inactive, cross-space, missing, or mismatched source input fails before provider invocation and provider call count remains zero
Self-harm, domestic-violence, and acute-medical fixtures bypass the provider and create no ordinary task or automatic shared signal
Every provider-derived string and nested value plus the final rendered draft and shared signal is disclosure-checked
The implementation uses version-fixed Unicode Default Full Case Folding rather than uppercase/lowercase closure or a locale heuristic
STRAẞE family detail, Straße family detail, and STRASSE family detail fail closed against each other in both directions
Final sigma, canonical-equivalent, fullwidth, case, whitespace, punctuation, symbol, containment, and one-code-point-edit variants fail closed
Creating a private message produces no shared signal, task, report fact, confirmation record, or cross-role query result
Consent is per signal and remains same-speaker, present, unexpired, and unrevoked through transaction-safe confirmation
Raw-evidence and private-message queries remain self-only even when another role guesses an identifier
Consent revocation, evidence invalidation, actor deactivation, visibility drift, or version drift during provider execution or before persistence yields zero shared writes
Invalid output, synchronous or asynchronous provider failure, timeout, and a second invalid output return needs_human_review without consequential mutation
Logs and errors contain only identifiers and bounded outcome metadata

tasks.title: Correct guarded attribution, confirmation replay, and exact reporting
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh responsibility capability from the exact accepted CONTRACT-CORR-003 SHA without merging or cherry-picking RESP-001, RESP-REPAIR-001, RESP-REPAIR-002, or any rejected Attempt. Before provider invocation, validate the active requesting actor and every exact selected signal, provenance, evidence, and source member; identities must agree and every source member must be active in the same space with analysisConsent enabled. Build the entire provider request only from server-owned allowlisted metadata and bounded redacted excerpts. Never forward an arbitrary caller promptVersion or any raw/private content, raw reference, or persistent entity identifier in any provider-bound field; validate the whole provider request and compare UUID forms case-insensitively. Synchronous throws, asynchronous rejection, timeout, and two invalid outputs must return bounded review with zero consequential mutation. Revalidate the guard after provider return. Issue only an opaque server-side integrity-bound draft receipt. Confirmation must atomically resolve idempotency, verify the same authorized actor and immutable server-side draft plus current guard, consume the receipt, and persist once; an exact replay after consumption returns the original domain, while a different actor, key, payload, or tampered draft fails without mutation. Resolve correction idempotency before mutable-state and no-op validation, generate audit identity and time only on a replay miss, and return the original content-free audit on replay. Import the CONTRACT-CORR-003 package-root exact timestamp comparator for report-period boundaries. Derive reports deterministically from the five persisted stages, separate hidden coordination from execution, exclude ineligible facts, and use frozen neutral Chinese templates without an LLM.

update_tasks.spec: Implement a fresh care capability against CONTRACT-CORR-003 and DATA-CORR-001 without merging any rejected attempt. Import the package-root exact timestamp comparator and use it for every acknowledgement-deadline decision; Date.parse, epoch-millisecond comparison, precision narrowing, and duplicate local timestamp parsers are forbidden. Read Clock.now once per command and use that reading for all deadline decisions, transition timestamps, idempotency persistence, and audits. Acknowledgement is timely only when server now is strictly before the acknowledgement deadline; equality or lateness cannot suppress escalation. Persist and audit the bounded handling resolution and retain it through closure. Enforce one PostgreSQL lock order: care events in deterministic ID order before care rules in deterministic ID order. Add a credential-free disposable PostgreSQL race test using existing locked dependencies and a care-local harness.
acceptance: Caller-controlled timestamps cannot backdate acknowledgement or handling
An unconfirmed draft rule cannot schedule, notify, acknowledge, or escalate
Only the subject actor can acknowledge and only the current escalation recipient can handle
Wrong-space, inactive, or unrelated actors fail closed without any event, rule, notification, idempotency, or audit mutation
Acknowledgement succeeds only when Clock.now is strictly before the deadline, including a one-microsecond positive margin
Equivalent instants expressed with different offsets and the exact deadline cannot suppress timeout or escalation
The existing escalated-to-acknowledged late path remains valid and is never classified as a timely acknowledgement
The implementation imports the contract comparator and contains no Date.parse, epoch-millisecond deadline comparison, or duplicate timestamp parser
Handling requires the current escalation recipient and persists and audits the bounded resolution
Closure preserves the handling resolution
Concurrent scheduler and acknowledgement transactions complete without deadlock, duplicate event, or contradictory terminal result
Repeated ticks, acknowledgements, and handling requests are idempotent
No path uses an LLM, wall-clock sleep, Date.now, or free-form care resolution
